mapper.select: select id, user_name, password, nick_name, email, status from sys_user
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user ( user_name, password, nick_name, email, status) values ( #{user.userName}, #{user.password}, #{user.nickName}, #{user.email}, #{user.status})
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from sys_user where id = #{id}
